Definition: a Shimathite (collectively) or descendants of Shimah
BiblicalUsage: The Shimathites are one of the families of the scribes who dwell at Jabez. They are named beside the Tirathites and the Suchathites.
TheologicalSignificance: Scribes are worth naming, because the men who kept the records kept the history I read.
